boxes.title: Rules of mate selection
items: **Exogamy**: outside own **gotra**; North India adds **village exogamy**
Tribal: capture (**Naga, Ho, Bhil, Gond**), service (**Gonds**), exchange ("Atta Satta")

items.what: **Age of Consent Act**: first measure vs child marriage
**Hindu Marriage Act**: not to STs; divorce **Sec. 13**
Triple talaq void; up to **3 years'** jail

boxes.title: Changing trends
items: Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat: eliminate by **2030**
Uberoi: companionate marriage, **serial monogamy**, more divorce
